Subject: New vendor: Redwood Inference — onboarding & invoice requirements

Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro. Orbitix is ready to onboard Redwood Inference as a vendor but we need a few items before we can activate your supplier record and issue POs. Please complete the attached AP onboarding form and return the following: 

- Legal company name, VAT/Tax ID (format for EU vendors) and any local registration numbers.
- W-8/W-9 or equivalent tax certification for cross-border payments.
- Preferred remittance instruction (bank account in GBP/EUR/USD + SWIFT/IBAN).
- Invoice format: we require a PDF that includes the Orbitix PO number in the subject line and the invoice header.
- GL code usage: do you prefer us to post a single GL at the PO level or provide GL per invoice line? We can accept either but need a consistent mapping.
- Electronic delivery: Orbitix accepts invoices via our AP portal (https://ap.orbitix.com/upload) or via SFTP drop (details in the attached form). Do you support invoice submission via SFTP/Peppol?

I attached the vendor onboarding packet and a CSV template that shows the GL codes we use. If you send a sample invoice (with mock amounts) we can run a quick validation. Once we receive the completed form and tax docs, we should be able to activate you within 48 hours.

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Senior Procurement Manager — Orbitix Secure

+44 20 7123 4567

Elena — thanks, will do. A few quick clarifications so we submit exactly what you need: 

1) VAT/Tax ID: Redwood is US-headquartered but we have an EU VAT registration (GB999999995). We will include both the US EIN and EU VAT in the form.

2) GL mapping: our standard is to include one primary GL code per invoice and an optional product/service code per line. If Orbitix requires line-level GLs, we can populate them but we prefer PO-level GL where possible to avoid rework on our side. Which is your canonical requirement for automated posting?

3) Invoice transmission: we can upload to your AP portal and can also drop to SFTP. We also support Peppol in the EU but would need Orbitix’s Peppol ID to test.

4) PO reference formatting: does Orbitix require the PO to appear exactly as “PO #{number}” in the invoice header and filename? We’ve seen some partners use different tokens which break the parsing.

I’m attaching a sample invoice (PDF) with mock values and the partially completed onboarding form. I’ll also attach our bank instructions and W-8BEN-E redacted copy; we’ll send the full tax doc via the secure DocuSign link if preferred.

Target: we’d like to get activated before the end of next week so we can bill the pilot. Please confirm whether you have any early-payment/fast-track enrollment for new strategic suppliers.

Best,

Hi Mina — thanks for the fast follow-up. A couple of clarifications inline and action items: 

- GL policy: Orbitix posts at the PO level by default. We will only accept line-level GLs for exceptions (multi-department invoices). Please set the primary GL in the "Invoice GL" field; if a line-level override is needed include the column "GL_LineCode" in your CSV.

- PO format: please put the PO exactly as PO123456789 (no prefixes or spaces). The parser looks for the token starting with 'PO' and 9 digits. If the PO is missing our system flags the invoice for manual review.

- Invoice delivery: portal upload is preferred (https://ap.orbitix.com/upload). SFTP credentials are provided below (SFTP host: sftp.orbitix.com, username provided after vendor activation). We will provide a Peppol ID if you want to test PEPPOL — ping this thread and we’ll arrange a test exchange.

- Tax docs: Please upload W-8/W-9 to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Envelope/ABC123DEF. That link will route documents securely to our tax team.

- Sample validation: your sample invoice looks fine but the field labeled "Service Code" needs to match our mapping in GL_Code_Mapping_v2.csv. I attached a corrected example with the expected column headers (INVOICE_NO, PO_NO, INVOICE_DATE, TOTAL, INVOICE_GL, SERVICE_CODE).

We created a temporary Supplier ID for Redwood: ORB-987654. After you return the completed staging packet we’ll enable account activation — estimated 48 business hours from receipt.

Regards,
AP Vendor Ops
Orbitix Secure
